thread:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — model-quality-drop detected for model 'redwood-chat-rlhf-v2' in eu-west1. Metric: rouge_drop > 12% across sampled eval-suite. Triggered by alerting rule: model-quality-regression-high.

pagerduty-bot: Pager duty triggered to oncall: maya.

maya: on it. pulling logs and evals now. can someone post recent deploy id?

ops-bot: last deploy: deploy-2026-03-15-21:02 (julie-eng). rolling config change: quantize=auto, rollout=100%.

julie-eng: yep that was me — thin-quantization path enabled for that model variant this morning. curious it's showing up in evals now.

sam: quick note — traffic shows spike in A/B test cohort using longer context; latency also up ~15% but main problem is generation truncation / hallucination increase.

eli: okay, first mitigation: recommend model pin to previous stable variant redwood-chat-rlhf-v2-stable (sha: abcd1234). We can route all prod traffic to stable for eu-west1.

maya: agree. plan: 1) pin routing for eu-west1 to stable, 2) rollback the quantization flag, 3) notify customers + status page. I'll own the pin and status page updates.

zoe-cs: I can draft customer-facing note for impacted customers (those with SLA > 99.9% and EU regs). need ETA and impact wording.

maya: ETA for pin: 10m. rollback of quantization path needs a small patch, julie, can you prepare quick rollback or disable flag remotely?

julie-eng: I can disable via runtime flag. prepping patch now. will push a canary in 5m then disable globally if green.

sam: adding a short-term traffic-split command in case we need gradual shift:```bash
# pin eu-west1 to stable variant
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/routing/pin 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
  -d '{"region":"eu-west1","model":"redwood-chat-rlhf-v2-stable","duration_minutes":60}'
```

maya: executing pin now.

maya: @ops-bot route pinned: eu-west1 -> redwood-chat-rlhf-v2-stable (duration 60m). Confirming traffic shift...

ops-bot: Routing change accepted. New split: eu-west1 100% -> redwood-chat-rlhf-v2-stable.

eli: monitoring eval pipeline now. pulling a fresh sample of 5k queries from the last 3h. will report quality delta in 12m.

julie-eng: pushed rollback disable patch to canary. logs look clean. proceeding to disable quantize path globally in 2m unless objections.

maya: proceed.

julie-eng: disabled. rolling restart of worker pool in eu-west1 initiated.

ops-bot: Deploy event: rollback-quantize-2026-03-15-21:20 completed on 12/12 workers.

sam: initial checks: generation length back to expected distribution, perplexity improved slightly. latency back within SLO.

eli: eval delta (post-pin+rollback): rouge_drop now 1.8% (was 12%). passing thresholds.

maya: great. drafting status page update and customer note. dropping drafts below, please review: 

--- STATUS PAGE DRAFT ---
Summary: We detected a regression in model outputs for redwood-chat-rlhf-v2 in eu-west1 and temporarily routed traffic to a previously stable variant. We have disabled a recent quantization change and validated quality has returned to expected levels.
Impact: A subset of customers using redwood-chat-rlhf-v2 in EU may have experienced degraded output quality and increased latency between 21:00–21:20 UTC.
Mitigation: Traffic routed to redwood-chat-rlhf-v2-stable; the quantization flag rollback applied.
Next steps: Full verification over 60 minutes and gradual unpin once baseline verified. No action required from customers.
--- END DRAFT ---

zoe-cs: Customer note draft: 
Hi — we detected and fixed an issue impacting output quality for our redwood-chat-rlhf-v2 model in EU. We routed traffic to a stable variant and rolled back a performance optimization. We validated improvements and continue monitoring. Sorry for the disruption — reach out if you saw issues.

maya: small edit to CS note to include times and contact link.

zoe-cs: updated: 
Hi — we identified a model-quality regression affecting redwood-chat-rlhf-v2 in eu-west1 between 21:00–21:20 UTC on 2026-03-15. We temporarily routed traffic to a stable model variant and disabled a quantization optimization. Output quality and latency have returned to expected levels; monitoring is ongoing. If you observed degraded output, please contact support@redwood.ai and include request id(s) if possible.

maya: ok sending CS note to priority customers now.

julie-eng: postmortem checklist: collect eval snapshots (pre/post), collect rollout logs, annotate deploy history, run canary regression tests tomorrow. tagging for postmortem: julie-eng, maya, eli, sam, zoe-cs.

maya: I'll open the incident doc and assign owners. quick checklist for handoff: 
- Confirm monitoring windows (60m)
- Keep pin active for 60m unless regression recurs
- Notify broader eng-channel after 60m if stable
- Prepare rollback-safe plan for any partial re-enable of quantize path

eli: monitoring looks stable at +30m. keeping an eye on edge cases.

sam: FYI: suggest adding a gating test in CI that exercises long-context A/B cohort to catch this earlier.

julie-eng: agreed. creating a follow-up ticket to add canary tests and a kill-switch for quantize path.

maya: handoff to oncall for the next 30m is @sam. I'll be available until 22:00 UTC. If anything flares, page me.

sam: taking handoff. will escalate if we see >5% deviation in quality or latency > SLO for more than 10m.

ops-bot: Note: incident marked as mitigated. create incident report with tags: model-quality, rollback, routing-pin, eu-west1.

maya: thanks team. postmortem owners assigned. closing thread for now — will reopen if we see new signals. :white_check_mark:
